auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.XCL_130 AS player_id,
        pa.XCL_132 AS height,
        pa.XCL_141 AS volley,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pa.XCL_132 DESC) AS rank_tallest,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pa.XCL_132 ASC) AS rank_shortest
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.XCL_132 IS NOT NULL AND pa.XCL_141 IS NOT NULL
),
TallestGroup AS (
    SELECT AVG(volley) AS avg_volley
    FROM RankedPlayers
    WHERE rank_tallest <= 10
),
ShortestGroup AS (
    SELECT AVG(volley) AS avg_volley
    FROM RankedPlayers
    WHERE rank_shortest <= 10
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN (SELECT avg_volley FROM TallestGroup) > (SELECT avg_volley FROM ShortestGroup) THEN 'Tallest'
        ELSE 'Shortest'
    END AS result
